body:
stop wasting time mining like a peasant 💀. Tuff VeinMiner is the most cracked mining plugin out there. no hunger drain, no destroying your expensive pickaxes, just pure efficiency.

✨ Why this is better than the others:
0 Hunger Cost: Mine the entire mountain, your stomach won't even growl. 🍔🚫

1 Tool Damage: I don't care if you break 50 diamond ores at once, your pickaxe only takes ONE point of damage. literally infinite durability hack 😭🙏.

Instant Loot: Get all your ores instantly so you can go back to building or whatever you actually do.

🛠️ How to Use
Just Crouch + Mine any ore vein.

Watch the whole thing collapse into your inventory.

That’s literally it. It’s that easy bro.
